issues.on_page: Contributions and grants 8,087 (shown as Operating Grants and Contributions on p2)
issues.issue: The line mixes grants and contributions. The grants may come from a government (intergovernmental/state aid or federal grants). This isn't marked review, and the same category is used in detail for Cemetery 1,100, Library 3,820 and Summer Sports 3,167.
The proprietary fund's capital outlay is recorded as 'utilities'. 'capital outlay' may fit better.

issues.on_page: Cemetery department, shown under 'Public works' on the General Fund budget schedule (p10). Statement Public works 52,985 = General 6,439 + Street 46,546 (p5)
issues.issue: The Cemetery department's spending (detail[30]-[33], 13,639) is classed health/welfare. The basic statement counts it in Public works, which the extraction mapped to streets/highways, so the detail function split doesn't tie to the statement's function columns. health/welfare is the rule's category for cemeteries, so this is defensible; only the mismatch needs noting.

issues.on_page: Capital outlay 1,064 (General), 7,200 (Cemetery), 7,695 (Library); total 15,959 = General Fund 'Capital outlay' function on p5
issues.issue: The General Fund department capital outlay lines (detail[28], [32], [38]) take their department's function. The statement reports these 15,959 as a separate Capital outlay function, so the detail function split doesn't tie to the statement.
